runtime_database: H2 2.1.214 in-memory (jdbc:h2:mem:seatunnel;MODE=MySQL;DB_CLOSE_DELAY=-1;DATABASE_TO_LOWER=true), schema from classpath script/seatunnel_server_h2.sql via Spring profile 'h2'

commands.command: java -Dseatunnel-web.logs.path=<output>/logs/app -cp seatunnel-app/target/classes:<runtime classpath> org.apache.seatunnel.app.SeatunnelApplication --spring.profiles.active=h2 --server.port=18200 --server.address=127.0.0.1 --jwt.secretKey=<local test key> --spring.h2.console.enabled=false --spring.autoconfigure.exclude=org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.hazelcast.HazelcastAutoConfiguration,org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.cassandra.CassandraAutoConfiguration,org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.data.cassandra.CassandraDataAutoConfiguration,org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.data.cassandra.CassandraReactiveDataAutoConfiguration,org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.elasticsearch.ElasticsearchRestClientAutoConfiguration,org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.mongo.MongoAutoConfiguration,org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.mongo.MongoReactiveAutoConfiguration,org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.kafka.KafkaAutoConfiguration,org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.data.redis.RedisAutoConfiguration,org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.influx.InfluxDbAutoConfiguration,org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.neo4j.Neo4jAutoConfiguration,org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.mail.MailSenderAutoConfiguration,org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.hazelcast.HazelcastJpaDependencyAutoConfiguration --mybatis-plus.configuration.log-impl=org.apache.ibatis.logging.stdout.StdOutImpl  (script: run/start.sh)
kill <pid from run/app.pid> (graceful Spring shutdown; done after run 1 and after run 2)
python3 run/batch1.py ... run/batch9.py (harness run/harness.py); results assembled by python3 run/gen.py

patches.description: Compatibility fix: VirtualTableMapper.checkVirtualTableNameUnique annotated its 4th argument @Param("datasourceId") while VirtualTableDaoImpl passes the current workspace id and the XML references #{workspaceId}; every virtual-table create/update failed with MyBatis BindingException. Renamed the @Param to workspaceId. No constraint/validation semantics changed.

logs.description: Run 1 (unpatched) application stdout incl. MyBatis SQL trace; JWTs redacted
Run 2 (patched, fresh H2) application stdout incl. SQL trace and shutdown; JWTs redacted
Logback file appender output for both runs
Index (with sha256) of the 193 per-case SQL-trace/log slices under logs/cases/

notes: Two start attempts failed before the successful run: Spring Boot HazelcastClientConfiguration tried to connect to a SeaTunnel engine on localhost:5801-5815 (not permitted), then CassandraAutoConfiguration hit a typesafe-config classpath conflict from connector jars. Both were resolved purely with --spring.autoconfigure.exclude (runtime configuration, no source change).
A non-empty jwt.secretKey is required (the shipped application.yml leaves it blank); a local test key was supplied on the command line.
Only the H2 profile was deployed. The MySQL schema context (dbctx-c15350c14606) was not deployed because a MySQL server would require an additional TCP port and the policy permits only 18200.

Run 1: cases before the patch (ws-, ds-, jd-, user-, jc-, task-, line-, vt-). Run 2: fresh in-memory DB after patch 0001 (r2-, vt2-, line2-, jv-, login-unknown-workspace, user-type-200, task-source-connector-...).
SeaTunnel job execution (/job/executor/execute) was intentionally not invoked since it submits to the SeaTunnel engine on a non-permitted port.
All started processes were stopped; port 18200 verified closed. Maven build artefacts (target/) remain inside the isolated application copy.

Revision 2 (validator corrections): no redeployment was needed; verification-results.json was regenerated from the same recorded evidence with corrected outcome/handling classifications. The application remains stopped and port 18200 is closed.

Revision 3: read-back cases now label their exchange evidence as kind 'read-back'; the directory reference logs/cases was replaced by the file logs/cases-index.json. No redeployment; application remains stopped.
